title: Crispy Gochujang Tofu
style: Air-fried tofu tossed in a sticky, sweet-spicy gochujang glaze, served over basmati with cool cucumber and salted edamame
description: Cornstarch-coated tofu air-fried until crisp, then glazed in a thick gochujang, soy, honey and sesame sauce. Served with rice, sliced cucumber and salted edamame — about 490 kcal and 31 g protein per serving.
steps: Press the tofu: Press the block to squeeze out excess moisture, then cut into bite-sized cubes.
Coat: Toss the tofu in a bowl with the olive oil, cornstarch and a pinch of salt until every piece is evenly coated.
Air-fry: Cook at 200°C for about 25 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through for even crisping.
Sauce: Meanwhile, whisk the sauce ingredients together in a small bowl. In a separate bowl, mix the cornflour with the cold water, then stir the slurry into the sauce.
Thicken: Pour into a pan and simmer over medium-low heat for 4 minutes, stirring, until glossy and thickened.
Glaze: Add the crispy tofu to the pan and toss until well coated. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve over rice with the sliced cucumber and salted edamame on the side.
tips: Press the tofu properly — drier tofu crisps faster and holds its crunch under the sauce.
Toss the tofu in the sauce right before serving so it doesn't go soft.
Swap the honey for maple syrup to make it vegan.
Frozen edamame works well: boil for 3–4 minutes, drain and salt.
